trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, settle into your Beachfront room, unpack, and get oriented with the resort amenities. Pick up a Disney park map and plan your week. Visit the resort pool area to relax after your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Take a leisurely stroll around Disney Springs — free admission, no park ticket required. Enjoy the waterfront atmosphere, browse shops, catch street performers, and soak in the Disney magic as a gentle introduction to the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during your flight to save money.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable bite at the airport — look for food courts or grab a sandwich to go.
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Try Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for affordable chicken tenders and sandwiches (~$12–$15 per person). Alternatively, grab a budget-friendly meal at Earl of Sandwich (~$8–$10).

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light due to afternoon arrival. Purchase a 7-day Magic Your Way ticket in advance online for the best savings. Download the My Disney Experience app to manage park reservations, check wait times, and grab Lightning Lane passes. Stock up on snacks and water bottles at a nearby Publix or Walmart to save on in-park food costs throughout the week.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Magic Kingdom — arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Use the Early Entry benefit if your resort qualifies (30 minutes before official opening). Priority rides: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Grab a classic Mickey-shaped waffle or breakfast at The Plaza Restaurant or a quick-service spot near the entrance.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Fantasyland for family-friendly rides like Peter Pan's Flight and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade (check the app for timing, usually early afternoon). Cool off with a Dole Whip from Aloha Isle (~$6) — an iconic and affordable Disney treat.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — Happily Ever After fireworks show (check app for exact time, usually 9:00–10:00 PM). Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. about 30–45 minutes before showtime. Head back to resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Columbia Harbour House or quick-service breakfast from your resort — bring a granola bar or fruit from your snack stash to save money.
meals.lunch: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable quick-service options (~$12–$15 for a burger or chicken meal).
meals.dinner: Pinocchio Village Haus near It's a Small World — flatbreads and pasta dishes (~$13–$16). Alternatively, pack a picnic-style dinner from resort snacks to eat near the fireworks viewing area.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — perfect for Day 2 energy. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane Individual passes for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train early in the morning as it sells out fast. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a small backpack with sunscreen, a refillable water bottle (free water is available at any quick-service counter), and a portable phone charger.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT — arrive at park opening. Start in World Discovery: check out Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane — grab your spot the moment the park opens via the app). Visit Test Track and Mission: SPACE for thrilling experiences.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase — walk around the 11 international pavilions representing countries like Mexico, Japan, France, and Canada. This is a budget-friendly way to experience world cultures. Catch live cultural performances and street entertainment (free with park admission). Visit the Mexico pavilion's Gran Fiesta Tour boat ride — low wait times and a relaxing break.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's HARMONIOUS nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Find a spot along the lagoon about 30 minutes before showtime. Explore the illuminated pavilions after the show before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before heading out — use your snack stash for a quick, free breakfast.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's most affordable and delicious quick-service spots. Sandwiches, grain bowls, and rotisserie chicken (~$12–$14).
meals.dinner: World Showcase food kiosks — budget strategy: share 2–3 small plates from different countries' kiosks for a fun, affordable international dinner experience (~$5–$10 per dish). Try Japan's sushi, Mexico's tacos, or Canada's cheddar cheese soup in a bread bowl.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is enormous — wear comfortable walking shoes. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan World Discovery and World Nature in the morning. If traveling with young children, prioritize Frozen Ever After in the Norway pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion. Free water refills are available at any quick-service location — just ask.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Hollywood Studios — arrive at park opening. Priority: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance first (use Lightning Lane or virtual queue — secure your spot the moment the park opens). Then head to Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore Galaxy's Edge and take in the incredible immersive Star Wars theming.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania! Explore the beautifully themed area and grab a photo with the giant toy blocks. Head to Sunset Boulevard and ride The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith — two thrilling back-to-back experiences.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater — a beloved water, fire, and projection spectacular. Arrive 30–45 minutes early for a good seat. Check the My Disney Experience app for show times. Head back to the resort after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort or bring snacks. Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land opens early and offers affordable breakfast items like a Lunch Box Tart (~$5) and Monte Cristo sandwich (~$12).
meals.lunch: Backlot Express near Echo Lake — one of Hollywood Studios' most budget-friendly quick-service restaurants. Burgers, chicken tenders, and sandwiches (~$11–$14).
meals.dinner: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed Star Wars cuisine. Portions are generous and prices are reasonable (~$13–$16 per entree). Try the Smoked Kaadu Ribs or Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken).

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is extremely popular — arrive early to maximize your time. Lightning Lane Multi Pass is worth considering for this park to skip lines for Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster. The Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge area is spectacular even without riding — explore Black Spire Outpost, visit Savi's Workshop (extra cost, ~$250) or just browse for the experience. Consider building a lightsaber only if budget allows as a splurge item.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Animal Kingdom — arrive at park opening (typically 8:00 AM, one of the earliest-opening parks). Priority: Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora - The World of Avatar (the most popular ride at the resort — lines can exceed 2 hours by mid-morning). Then explore the stunning bioluminescent beauty of Pandora and ride Na'vi River Journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and Asia sections of Animal Kingdom. Ride Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-air safari through a 110-acre savanna with real African animals including lions, elephants, giraffes, and hippos. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail (free, self-guided walking trail with gorillas, hippos, and exotic birds). Ride Expedition Everest in Asia for a thrilling roller coaster experience.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light or check the app for the current evening entertainment offering at Animal Kingdom (shows vary by season). Explore Discovery Island and the Tree of Life — walk around the base to discover 325 animals carved into its trunk. Head back to resort for an early night to recharge.

meals.breakfast: Eat at resort before heading out. Grab a quick snack from Starbucks at the park entrance if needed.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — widely considered one of the best quick-service restaurants in all of Disney World. Smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating (~$14–$17). Arrive before noon to beat the lunch rush.
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — customizable grain bowls and bao buns with unique Avatar-themed ingredients (~$13–$16). One of the most nutritious and filling quick-service options in the resort. Alternatively, head back to Disney Springs for a budget dinner at The BOATHOUSE's happy hour or Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza (~$10–$12).

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the early morning when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. The park can feel very hot and humid by midday in June — plan to take a midday break at your resort pool if energy dips. Bring bug spray as the park has more outdoor, natural areas. The Kilimanjaro Safaris experience is different morning vs. evening — morning offers better animal activity.

day_by_day.morning: Take a free resort rest morning — sleep in, enjoy the Aegean Bliss Resort's Beachfront amenities. Swim at the resort pool, relax on the beach area, and recharge after five intense park days. This is a budget-friendly way to enjoy your accommodation's included amenities without spending extra.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney's BoardWalk — free admission, no park ticket needed. Stroll the 1920s Atlantic City-style boardwalk along Crescent Lake. Watch street performers, browse shops, and enjoy the lakeside atmosphere. Take the free friendship boat to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance for a bonus EPCOT visit — use your park ticket for a few hours to catch anything you missed on Day 3. Focus on any rides with shorter afternoon wait times.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for a second evening visit — use any remaining park hopper benefit or revisit with your multi-day ticket. Focus on rides you missed or want to re-experience. Stay for the electric Main Street Electrical Parade if scheduled (check the app). Alternatively, spend the evening at Disney Springs for free entertainment, shopping, and dining.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — use your snack supplies for a free meal at your room (cereal, fruit, yogurt bought from a nearby grocery store).
meals.lunch: Disney's BoardWalk: AbracadaBar for drinks or grab a quick snack from the BoardWalk Bakery — fresh pastries and sandwiches (~$8–$12).
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Raglan Road Irish Pub — live Irish music and entertainment is free with dinner. Hearty Irish-American dishes (~$15–$20 per entree). Budget alternative: Food trucks at Disney Springs offer meals from ~$10–$14.

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally lighter to avoid park fatigue — a common issue on longer Disney trips. Use this day for resort relaxation, souvenir shopping at Disney Springs (more affordable than in-park shops), and catching up on any park experiences missed earlier in the week. Check the My Disney Experience app for any special events or character meet-and-greets available this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Final park day — return to your favorite park for one last magical morning. Recommended: Magic Kingdom for a nostalgic final visit. Arrive at rope drop and prioritize any rides or experiences you want to experience one more time. Visit Main Street U.S.A. for last-minute souvenir shopping — the shops here have the widest selection at Disney World.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout is 11:00 AM — request late checkout if your departure allows). Store luggage with the bell services desk if needed. Spend your final afternoon at Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping, dining, and soaking in the Disney atmosphere one final time. Browse the World of Disney store — the largest Disney merchandise store in the world.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Allow at least 2–3 hours before your flight for transportation and security. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — use up any remaining snack supplies or treat yourself to one last resort breakfast as a send-off.
meals.lunch: Magic Kingdom or Disney Springs — treat yourself to one final Disney meal. Consider a classic like Casey's Corner hot dogs at Magic Kingdom (~$9–$11) for an affordable, iconic Disney farewell meal.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pack snacks from your remaining supplies for the journey home. Most Orlando Airport terminals have affordable food court options (~$10–$15).

day_by_day.notes: On your final day, use the My Disney Experience app to check for any last-minute Lightning Lane availability for rides you haven't tried. Purchase any remaining souvenirs at Disney Springs rather than inside the parks — prices are the same but the atmosphere is less rushed. Take photos at your favorite spots for lasting memories. Consider purchasing Disney PhotoPass photos from your week if any were taken — look for bundle deals. Safe travels home!

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In — Flight LH lands at 13:00, so no morning activities. Use this time to rest on the plane and prepare your park plans.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hotel Check-In & Resort Exploration — Arrive at Aegean Bliss Resort, check into your Beachfront room, unpack, and get oriented. Take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds, locate the pool, and pick up a Disney World park map. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done and link your tickets.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Shopping Experience — Head to Disney Springs (complimentary resort transportation available) for a relaxed first evening. Browse over 150 shops including World of Disney, enjoy live entertainment at the waterfront, and ease into the Disney magic without the intensity of a full park day.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the plane or grab a light snack at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: Pick up a quick bite at the resort's casual poolside café or grab a snack upon arrival — try a resort grab-and-go sandwich or wrap (~$12–16).
meals.dinner: Dinner at The Boathouse at Disney Springs — enjoy waterfront dining with fresh seafood and steaks. Mid-range entrées $22–38. Alternatively, try Blaze Pizza for a budget-friendly option (~$12–15).

day_by_day.notes: Do not over-schedule Day 1 — travel fatigue is real. Use the My Disney Experience app to make Lightning Lane reservations for upcoming park days. Resort shuttle to Disney Springs runs every 20 minutes. Wear comfortable shoes from the start.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park — Arrive at rope drop (park typically opens 9:00 AM). Head immediately to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if pre-booked. Explore Cinderella Castle and catch the opening welcome show.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Continued — After lunch, tackle Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use the hottest midday hours (1–3 PM) for indoor rides and shows like Mickey's PhilharMagic. Grab a Dole Whip at Aloha Isle for a classic Disney treat.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Nighttime Spectacular — Stay for the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check times) and the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle. This is a bucket-list Disney moment best experienced on Day 2 when energy is still high.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort before heading out — try the resort's buffet or continental spread (~$15–20 per person).
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — counter service with clam chowder, fish and chips, and sandwiches (~$14–18). Relatively quick and air-conditioned.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant (inside Magic Kingdom, Beauty and the Beast themed) — book well in advance. Prix-fixe dinner ~$62 per adult, $37 per child. Alternatively, Skipper Canteen for a mid-range sit-down option (~$18–28 entrées).

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass ($25–35/person/day) to skip queues on top rides. Wear sunscreen — June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs ~92°F/33°C). Stay hydrated with free water cups available at any quick-service location. Magic Kingdom is the most popular park — arrive early.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for opening (typically 9:00 AM). Start in Future World/World Discovery with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind or Test Track. Then make your way to the World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Exploration — Spend the afternoon sampling authentic cuisine and cultural experiences across the 11 country pavilions. Visit Mexico (Gran Fiesta Tour boat ride), Norway (Frozen Ever After), Japan (Mitsukoshi store), France (Remy's Ratatouille Adventure), and Morocco. Take your time — this is a leisurely, culture-rich experience.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Show — Wrap up the evening with EPCOT's stunning nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon featuring fireworks, fountains, and music. Grab a spot near the Italy or France pavilion for the best views.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort or a grab-and-go pastry at EPCOT's Connections Café (~$8–12).
meals.lunch: World Showcase food stalls — graze your way around the world! Try a Croissant Donut in France (~$6), School Bread in Norway (~$5), and Tacos in Mexico (~$10–14). Budget ~$25–35 for a satisfying lunch across multiple stops.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in Japan Pavilion — hibachi-style tableside cooking, a fun and interactive dinner experience. Entrées ~$28–42 per person. Reserve in advance via My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is perfect for foodies — bring extra snack budget. The park is more walkable and relaxed than Magic Kingdom. June often brings EPCOT's International Food & Wine Festival events — check the schedule for bonus tastings and live music. Comfortable walking shoes are essential as World Showcase is a 1.3-mile loop.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Resort Morning — Take a well-deserved rest morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy the beachfront amenities, swim in the pool, or relax on the beach. This mid-trip break prevents burnout and keeps energy high for the remaining days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Head to Hollywood Studios after lunch. Make a beeline for Galaxy's Edge: ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and Rise of the Resistance (book Individual Lightning Lane for this — $20–25 per person). Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (~$249.99) or Droid Depot to build a droid (~$119.99) if budget allows — these are premium but unforgettable experiences.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios Evening — Catch the Fantasmic! nighttime show (check schedule — typically 9:00 PM). Also explore Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. The park has a fantastic evening atmosphere with great lighting and entertainment.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast — enjoy the beachfront setting with a full breakfast at the resort restaurant (~$18–24 per person).
meals.lunch: Lunch at the resort pool bar or café before heading to Hollywood Studios (~$14–20).
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant at Hollywood Studios — eat in retro cars while watching classic sci-fi movie clips. A uniquely fun atmosphere. Entrées ~$22–35. Book in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Rise of the Resistance is the most in-demand attraction at Disney World — book Individual Lightning Lane at exactly 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Lightsaber building at Savi's Workshop requires a reservation and is a splurge, but is widely considered a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The rest morning is strategically placed to recharge before the final park days.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom — Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive early for Kilimanjaro Safaris (best wildlife activity in the morning when animals are most active). See lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and more in a 20-minute open-air vehicle tour through a simulated African savanna. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pandora — The World of Avatar — After lunch, explore Pandora. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (book Lightning Lane — this is one of Disney's most popular rides). Also experience Na'vi River Journey for a beautiful, relaxing boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest. The afternoon light in Pandora is magical.
day_by_day.evening: Animal Kingdom Evening & Tree of Life — Watch the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show at dusk (every 10–15 minutes as darkness falls). Explore Discovery Island and catch any remaining shows. Note: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8–9 PM), so plan accordingly.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before rope drop — Animal Kingdom requires an early start for the safari. Grab a quick continental breakfast at the resort (~$10–15).
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue — one of Disney's best counter-service restaurants. Smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating. Meals ~$16–22.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Animal Kingdom — Asian-fusion cuisine in a beautifully themed setting. Entrées ~$22–34. Alternatively, head back to Disney Springs for a wider dinner selection if Animal Kingdom closes early.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is a genuine wildlife park — treat it with respect and keep voices low near animal habitats. Flight of Passage is a must-do but has long waits — Lightning Lane is strongly recommended. The park is most beautiful in the morning golden hour. Bring insect repellent as the park has natural vegetation and open-air areas.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Return — Second Visit for Missed Attractions — Return to Magic Kingdom to catch anything missed on Day 2. Focus on: Jungle Cruise, The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh, Tomorrowland Speedway, and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin. Take time to browse Main Street, U.S.A. shops for souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT Return — Future World Deep Dive — Head back to EPCOT for the afternoon to experience Future World attractions: Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (if not done), Soarin' Around the World, Mission: SPACE (choose Orange Mission for the full experience), and Living with the Land boat ride.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Disney Springs Evening — Spend the final evening at Disney Springs for shopping, entertainment, and a celebratory farewell dinner. Pick up last-minute souvenirs at World of Disney. Enjoy the waterfront entertainment and live music.

meals.breakfast: Character Breakfast at Magic Kingdom's Crystal Palace — dine with Winnie the Pooh, Piglet, Eeyore, and Tigger. All-you-care-to-enjoy buffet ~$45–55 per adult, ~$27–32 per child. Book well in advance — this is a popular experience.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons at EPCOT's The Land Pavilion — healthy and varied counter-service options including grain bowls, rotisserie chicken, and sandwiches (~$14–19). Conveniently located near Soarin'.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — upscale steakhouse with a lively atmosphere. Splurge-worthy farewell dinner. Steaks ~$45–65, but worth it for a special occasion. Alternatively, The Edison for a more theatrical mid-range experience (~$25–40 entrées).

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at Disney World — arrive early at both parks. Use Lightning Lane strategically. The Character Breakfast at Crystal Palace is a wonderful family memory — especially meaningful for younger children. Consider purchasing any remaining souvenirs today to avoid a last-minute rush on Day 7.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed Resort Morning & Checkout Prep — Enjoy a final leisurely morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Take one last swim, enjoy the beachfront view, and savor a slow breakfast. Begin packing and prepare for checkout. Request a late checkout if available to maximize resort time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Disney Souvenir Shopping & Departure Prep — If time permits before departure transfers, make a quick stop at Disney Springs or the resort gift shop for any last-minute souvenirs. Confirm transportation to the airport and allow extra time for Orlando traffic (MCO is approximately 20–30 minutes from Disney World).
day_by_day.evening: Departure — Head to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before international flights for check-in, security, and boarding. Reflect on an incredible week of Disney magic!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — treat yourself to a full sit-down meal at the resort restaurant. Enjoy the beachfront ambiance one last time (~$18–25 per person).
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort café or Disney Springs if time allows — keep it simple for travel day (~$12–18).
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO — Orlando International has solid dining options including Outback Steakhouse, Chick-fil-A, and various grab-and-go options for the flight home (~$15–25).

day_by_day.notes: Check your flight time carefully and work backward for departure planning — Orlando traffic can be unpredictable, especially on Sunday afternoons. Store luggage with the resort concierge if checkout is before your transfer time. Take photos of the resort and your room for lasting memories. Keep all Disney tickets and MagicBands as souvenirs — they make wonderful keepsakes!

experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride and the Na'vi River Journey. End the day with the Rivers of Light nighttime show.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora – The World of Avatar, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight LH arrives at 13:00. Relax during the flight and prepare for arrival.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Transfer via private luxury car service to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in to your Beachfront suite, unpack, and enjoy a welcome amenity. Take a leisurely orientation stroll around the resort grounds, explore the beachfront pool area, and familiarize yourself with Disney World's transportation options from the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Ease into the trip with a magical first evening at Disney Springs. Explore the waterfront entertainment district, browse flagship luxury shops, and soak in the atmosphere with live street performances. End the evening with a world-class dinner at a signature restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the flight or grab a light bite at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: In-flight meal or a quick premium grab-and-go option at Orlando International Airport's Airside lounges upon arrival.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant offering premium omakase-style dining, wagyu beef, whole Peking duck, and an extensive cocktail menu in a stunning two-story setting.

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance through the resort's concierge. Request early check-in if possible so the suite is ready upon arrival. Pick up your Disney MagicBand+ wristbands at the resort front desk and link them to your My Disney Experience app. Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane selections for upcoming park days tonight to secure prime times.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day — Begin with an early morning rope-drop entry using Disney's Early Theme Park Entry benefit (available to resort guests). Head straight to TRON Lightcycle Run and Space Mountain with Individual Lightning Lane passes secured. Explore Fantasyland classics including Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and ride Pirates of the Caribbean before the midday crowds build. Enjoy the iconic Main Street U.S.A. atmosphere and snap photos in front of Cinderella Castle.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom adventure through the afternoon. Experience Haunted Mansion, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and the newly expanded Tomorrowland attractions. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass to skip standby queues. Take a mid-afternoon break at a premium in-park lounge to recharge before the evening spectaculars begin. Reserve a prime viewing spot for the afternoon parade.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the full Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — Disney Enchantment fireworks and projection show illuminating Cinderella Castle. Experience the park's magical transformation after dark with evening ambiance, lit-up attractions, and reduced crowds. Depart via resort monorail back to the hotel in style.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Magic Kingdom — A fairytale breakfast inside Cinderella Castle with character meet-and-greets featuring Disney Princesses. Book 60 days in advance; a true bucket-list luxury dining experience.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland — Dine in the enchanted Beast's Castle with a premium prix-fixe menu. Request the West Wing dining room for the most immersive atmosphere.
meals.dinner: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — Panoramic rooftop views of Magic Kingdom fireworks with a farm-to-table menu featuring sushi, wood-fired dishes, and an award-winning wine list. Perfect timing to watch Enchantment from the rooftop terrace.

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at Magic Kingdom gates 30–45 minutes before official opening to maximize Early Entry. Wear comfortable premium sneakers — expect 15,000+ steps. Stay hydrated in the June heat; the resort concierge can arrange a personalized hydration and sunscreen kit. Cinderella's Royal Table and California Grill reservations must be booked 60 days prior via My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for Early Entry and head to Future World first, experiencing Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Individual Lightning Lane) and Test Track. Then transition into the World Showcase as pavilions open. Begin a curated cultural journey through the 11 country pavilions — start with Japan, Morocco, and France for the most immersive morning atmosphere with fewer crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the World Showcase food and culture exploration through the afternoon. Sample authentic cuisine and artisan beverages at each pavilion — Norwegian school bread and aquavit in Norway, French macarons and wine in France, hand-rolled sushi in Japan, and craft beers in Germany. Experience the cultural performances, folk art galleries, and artisan demonstrations. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion and Frozen Ever After in Norway.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the EPCOT experience with the breathtaking EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Secure a premium viewing spot at the Italy Pavilion waterfront. Depart feeling culturally enriched and fully immersed in global flavors.

meals.breakfast: The Garden Grill Restaurant at EPCOT's The Land Pavilion — A rotating, farm-to-table character dining experience with Chip 'n' Dale and friends. Features produce grown on-site in the Living with the Land greenhouse.
meals.lunch: Graze across multiple World Showcase pavilions — curate a premium food tour with dishes from Le Cellier Steakhouse (Canada) for a signature Canadian cheddar cheese soup, plus artisan tastings from Japan, France, and Italy pavilion kiosks.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul at EPCOT's France Pavilion — An upscale French fine-dining restaurant inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Offers classic French cuisine including duck foie gras, bouillabaisse, and a distinguished wine cellar in an elegant Parisian setting.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is one of the most walkable Disney experiences — comfortable footwear is essential. Consider booking a private VIP guided tour through Disney's VIP Tour Services for a dedicated guide, private transportation, and Lightning Lane access at all attractions. The EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival runs seasonally — if active in June 2027, additional food kiosks and celebrity chef demonstrations will be available.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at Hollywood Studios for Early Entry and head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Begin with Rise of the Resistance (Individual Lightning Lane secured in advance) — widely considered the most immersive theme park attraction ever built. Then visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom, hand-crafted lightsaber in a private ceremony — a deeply personal and premium keepsake experience (book 60 days in advance; limited capacity).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Hollywood Studios adventure. Visit the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on piloting experience. Explore the Droid Depot to build a custom astromech droid companion. Transition to the rest of the park for Tower of Terror and Slinky Dog Dash using Lightning Lane. Catch the Beauty and the Beast Live on Stage and Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular afternoon shows.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' epic nighttime spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse in a dream sequence battle against Disney villains, with live performers, water screens, and pyrotechnics. Secure a premium Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed reserved seating with a premium dinner included.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort's signature beachfront restaurant — enjoy a leisurely premium buffet or à la carte service at Aegean Bliss Resort before heading to the park.
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina inside Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — The galaxy's most unique bar experience featuring exotic cocktails, non-alcoholic specialty drinks, DJ R-3X spinning cantina beats, and small bites. Reservations essential; extremely high demand.
meals.dinner: Fantasmic! Dining Package at Hollywood Brown Derby — Art Deco-inspired fine dining with signature Cobb Salad (invented here), premium steaks, and the Grapefruit Cake. Package includes guaranteed Fantasmic! reserved seating.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building experience costs approximately $299 per lightsaber and must be booked 60 days in advance — do not miss this reservation as it sells out immediately. The Droid Depot experience costs approximately $119–$149. Bring a tote bag for Galaxy's Edge merchandise. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute time limit per visit and requires reservations.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive at Animal Kingdom for Early Entry and head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (Individual Lightning Lane) — a breathtaking banshee-riding simulator over the bioluminescent world of Pandora. Then experience Na'vi River Journey for a serene, visually stunning float through a mystical rainforest. Explore the Pandora landscape during the quieter morning hours when bioluminescent details are most vivid.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris — board an open-air safari vehicle for a guided expedition through 110 acres of authentic African savanna. Observe free-roaming lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, rhinos, zebras, and over 30 other species in naturalistic habitats. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for close encounters with western lowland gorillas and African wildlife. Experience DINOSAUR and Expedition Everest – Legend of the Forbidden Mountain with Lightning Lane access.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Animal Kingdom's magical transformation at night — the Tree of Life Awakening projection show brings the iconic 14-story tree to life with glowing animal spirits. Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (if operating) offers a serene water and light show. Depart for a relaxing resort evening with a spa treatment booked at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most acclaimed signature dining experience. Features globally inspired cuisine reflecting the travels of Disney Imagineers, with original artwork and artifacts adorning the walls. Exceptional weekend brunch menu.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – The World of Avatar — Healthy, flavorful bowls featuring wholesome grains, proteins, and signature sauces inspired by Na'vi cuisine. One of Disney's best quick-service options with premium ingredients.
meals.dinner: Jiko – The Cooking Place at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge — Award-winning African-inspired cuisine in a stunning lodge setting. Features one of the largest collections of South African wines in the United States. Signature dishes include oak-grilled filet mignon and maize-crusted fish.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active during safaris — the afternoon heat reduces animal visibility. Wear light, breathable clothing and apply sunscreen generously. Book a private VIP Safari experience for an exclusive small-group after-hours or early-morning safari with a dedicated naturalist guide. The resort spa should be booked in advance for an evening massage after a full day of walking.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Dining & Shopping Experience (Morning Exploration) — Begin with a leisurely late morning at Disney Springs. Visit the World of Disney flagship store, LEGO Store, and luxury boutiques including Pandora Jewelry and the Disney Couture jewelry collection. Explore the artisan marketplace and browse unique Disney collectibles, limited-edition artwork, and premium memorabilia. Visit the NBA Experience for interactive basketball activities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a full afternoon of leisure and resort indulgence. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a premium pool experience at the beachfront. Book a couples or family spa treatment at the resort spa — choose from signature massages, facials, or hydrotherapy experiences. Alternatively, take a premium Disney water sports experience on the resort's lake — paddleboarding, kayaking, or a private pontoon boat charter.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Disney Springs for the full evening entertainment experience. Enjoy world-class live music at the House of Blues or Raglan Road Irish Pub. Explore the rooftop bars and waterfront lounges. Experience the Cirque du Soleil Drawn to Life show — a spectacular acrobatic performance celebrating Disney animation (book in advance). End the night with dessert and nightcaps at a premium waterfront venue.

meals.breakfast: In-resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — enjoy a relaxed, luxurious room service breakfast on your beachfront balcony with fresh pastries, tropical fruits, eggs Benedict, and premium coffee.
meals.lunch: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — An upscale modern steakhouse with a lively atmosphere. Features premium USDA prime steaks, fresh seafood, truffle fries, and an extensive cocktail program. Perfect for a long, indulgent Saturday lunch.
meals.dinner: Paddlefish at Disney Springs — A stunning multi-deck seafood restaurant aboard a reimagined steamboat. Features premium fresh seafood, whole Maine lobster, king crab, oysters, and an impressive wine and cocktail list with panoramic waterfront views.

day_by_day.notes: Cirque du Soleil Drawn to Life tickets should be booked well in advance — premium seats in the VIP section offer the best viewing angles and include a pre-show reception. Disney Springs is free to enter with complimentary parking — no park ticket required. Saturday evenings at Disney Springs are the busiest; arrive early for dinner reservations. Consider a private shopping experience at World of Disney for personalized assistance and early access.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning — Revisit Your Favorite Park or Relaxation Day. Based on the week's experiences, choose a leisurely return to a favorite park using Early Entry for one final bucket-list attraction, or opt for a tranquil final morning at the resort. Enjoy the beachfront, take a sunrise walk around the resort grounds, and savor a slow, luxurious breakfast. Pack and prepare for departure, arranging late checkout with the concierge if your flight allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final afternoon at leisure — last-minute Disney Springs shopping for premium souvenirs, Disney artwork, and gifts. Visit the Disney's Art of Entertainment gallery for collectible prints and original animation cels. Pick up personalized Disney merchandise and custom-made items ordered earlier in the week. Arrange private luxury car transfer to Orlando International Airport through the resort concierge.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando with magical memories. If the flight is late evening, consider a farewell dinner at one of Disney World's most iconic resort restaurants before heading to the airport. Reflect on an extraordinary week of premium Disney magic.

meals.breakfast: Victoria & Albert's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — Disney World's only AAA Five Diamond restaurant and one of America's most celebrated fine-dining experiences. Features an exquisite multi-course tasting menu with optional wine pairings, prepared tableside by a world-class culinary team. Book 60 days in advance; jacket required. The ultimate luxury Disney farewell breakfast or brunch.
meals.lunch: Narcoossee's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — Waterfront fine dining with stunning views of the Seven Seas Lagoon and Magic Kingdom. Features premium seafood, Maine lobster bisque, and a curated wine list. A perfect, elegant final lunch with a view.
meals.dinner: If departing late: Capa Steakhouse at Four Seasons Resort Orlando — Rooftop Spanish-inspired steakhouse with panoramic Magic Kingdom fireworks views. Features prime dry-aged steaks, Spanish tapas, and an award-winning wine program. The perfect luxury send-off dinner.

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout (typically 1:00 PM–2:00 PM for premium guests) through the resort concierge to maximize the final morning. Arrange bell services to hold luggage after checkout while you enjoy final activities. Confirm private car transfer to the airport at least 3 hours before departure to allow for Orlando traffic. Victoria & Albert's requires reservations exactly 60 days in advance and is one of the hardest Disney reservations to secure — plan accordingly. Ensure all Lightning Lane charges, dining reservations, and MagicBand+ purchases are settled before departure.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
